title: (R)LANG.------POL.P.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 300 (PR.S(RD)II-54). LANG (language) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POL-P (political policies) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-INFO-DT, AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and TRS (transition). From CULT-INFO-DT: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From INFO-DE-B: INFO-F (information focus). From AF-DY: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: PER-DY (perception dynamics). From TRS: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics).
